entities.name: Clan Capashen
entities.description: One of the seven ruling clans of Benalia, descended from Sheoltun nobility and chosen for Urza's Bloodline Project.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: Dominarian realm ruled by seven clans.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker who chose Clan Capashen for his Bloodline Project.

entities.name: Danitha Capashen
entities.description: Current leader of the clan after her father's death; killed her compleated father.

entities.name: Aron Capashen
entities.description: Clan leader, father of Raff and Danitha; compleated by Ertai and killed by Danitha.

entities.name: Nathan Capashen
entities.description: Clan leader who agreed to the marriage of Jaffry Capashen and Myrr Ortovi.

entities.name: Jaffry Capashen
entities.description: Involved in Urza's bloodline project with Myrr Ortovi.

entities.name: Myrr Ortovi
entities.description: Wife of Jaffry in Urza's bloodline project.

entities.name: Raddeus Capashen
entities.description: Clan Chief at the start of the Phyrexian Invasion, killed by Tsabo Tavoc's minions and reanimated by Yawgmoth's Death Cloud.

entities.name: Tsabo Tavoc
entities.description: Phyrexian whose minions killed Raddeus and Leda.

entities.name: Rafwyn Capashen
entities.description: Tolarian prodigy and former navigator of the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Ellyn Capashen
entities.description: Tax official who joined the army after saving Purceon Capashen.

events.summary: Urza chooses Clan Capashen for his Bloodline Project.
